Definition: , or simpler στρωννύω; prolongation from a still simpler στρόω, (used only as an alternate in certain tenses) (probably akin to G4731 through the idea of positing); to "strew," i.e. spread (as a carpet or couch):--make bed, furnish, spread, strew.
